records.name: Child Care Services (CCS) Scholarships
records.organization: Texas Workforce Commission (with local Workforce Solutions boards)
records.description_en: Helps low-income Texas families pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school or job training. Families pay a small share based on income.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de Texas con pocos ingresos a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos para que los padres puedan trabajar, buscar trabajo o ir a la escuela o a una capacitación. La familia paga una pequeña parte según sus ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children from birth to age 12 (up to 18 with a disability). A single parent must work, train, or go to school about 25 hours a week (50 combined hours for two parents), and family income must be under the state limit.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde recién nacidos hasta los 12 años (hasta los 18 si tienen una discapacidad). Si es un solo padre o madre, debe trabajar, capacitarse o estudiar unas 25 horas por semana (50 horas entre los dos si son dos padres), y los ingresos de la familia deben estar por debajo del límite del estado.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

records.how_to_apply: Create a Parent Central account on Texas Child Care Connection, then fill out the Eligibility Screener and Waitlist Application. When your local board calls you off the waitlist, send the full application and documents.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cree una cuenta de Parent Central en Texas Child Care Connection y luego llene el formulario de elegibilidad y la solicitud para la lista de espera. Cuando la oficina local lo llame de la lista de espera, envíe la solicitud completa y sus documentos.
records.cost: Free to apply; sliding-scale parent share of cost (no more than 7% of household income)
records.notes: BCY2027 (Oct 1, 2026 - Sep 30, 2027) statewide CCS income limits: family of 2 up to $64,874/yr ($5,406/mo); family of 3 up to $80,139/yr ($6,678/mo); family of 4 up to $95,403/yr ($7,950/mo). Parent share of cost capped at 7% of household income. Most local boards have waitlists (often 3-15 months). Full-time undergraduate students can get CCS for up to 60 months total. Main TWC child care line 800-628-5115; email ccel@twc.texas.gov. Local board offices are listed as separate regional records. Income limits confirmed from TWC BCY2027 Income Eligibility chart.

records.name: Texas Rising Star
records.description_en: Texas Rising Star is a quality rating for child care programs, from Entry Level up to Four-Star. It helps parents find child care that goes above the state's minimum rules.
records.description_es: Texas Rising Star es una calificación de calidad para programas de cuidado infantil, desde Nivel Inicial hasta Cuatro Estrellas. Ayuda a los padres a encontrar cuidado infantil que va más allá de las reglas mínimas del estado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Any parent can use Texas Rising Star ratings to choose child care. Rated programs are child care providers that take CCS scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier padre o madre puede usar las calificaciones de Texas Rising Star para escoger cuidado infantil. Los programas calificados son proveedores que aceptan becas de cuidado infantil (CCS).
records.how_to_apply: Search for child care on the Texas Child Care Connection availability portal and filter by Texas Rising Star.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque cuidado infantil en el portal de disponibilidad de Texas Child Care Connection y use el filtro de Texas Rising Star.
records.cost: Free to search
records.notes: Quality rating and improvement system (QRIS). Certified programs get higher reimbursement rates for CCS children. Use this to point parents to higher-quality care.

records.name: Find Child Care Near Me (Child Care Availability Portal and Licensing Search)
records.organization: Texas Workforce Commission and Texas HHSC Child Care Regulation
records.description_en: Free online search for child care in Texas. You can filter by distance, openings, hours, Texas Rising Star rating, and more, and look up each provider's inspection records.
records.description_es: Búsqueda gratis en internet para encontrar cuidado infantil en Texas. Puede filtrar por distancia, lugares disponibles, horario, calificación de Texas Rising Star y más, y ver los reportes de inspección de cada proveedor.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone looking for child care in Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para cualquier persona que busque cuidado infantil en Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Search at the Texas Child Care Connection availability portal. To check a provider's license and inspections, use the HHSC Child Care Regulation search.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque en el portal de disponibilidad de Texas Child Care Connection. Para revisar la licencia y las inspecciones de un proveedor, use la búsqueda de Regulación de Cuidado Infantil de HHSC.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: Licensing/inspection search: https://childcare.hhs.texas.gov/Public/ChildCareSearch

records.name: Head Start and Early Head Start
records.organization: U.S. Dept. of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families (Office of Head Start), run by local agencies
records.description_en: Free early learning, health screenings, meals, and family support for young children. Head Start serves ages 3 to 5; Early Head Start serves babies and toddlers under 3 and many serve pregnant women.
records.description_es: Educación temprana gratis, revisiones de salud, comidas y apoyo para la familia para niños pequeños. Head Start atiende a niños de 3 a 5 años; Early Head Start atiende a bebés y niños menores de 3 años, y muchos programas también atienden a mujeres embarazadas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children birth to 5 in families at or below the federal poverty guidelines, or who get TANF, SSI, or SNAP. Children in foster care or who are homeless also qualify. Children with disabilities are welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde recién nacidos hasta los 5 años de familias con ingresos iguales o menores a las guías federales de pobreza, o que reciben TANF, SSI o SNAP. También califican los niños en cuidado de crianza (foster care) o sin hogar. Los niños con discapacidades son bienvenidos.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Head Start Center Locator to find a program near you, then contact that program to apply. Programs keep waiting lists when full.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el Localizador de Centros de Head Start para encontrar un programa cerca de usted y luego comuníquese con ese programa para solicitar. Si están llenos, tienen listas de espera.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: Programs may accept a limited number of children above the income limit. Many programs also serve pregnant/expectant families. Migrant and Seasonal Head Start serves farmworker families. Center locator (confirmed live): https://headstart.gov/center-locator

records.name: Texas Public School Pre-K
records.organization: Texas Education Agency and local school districts
records.description_en: Free pre-kindergarten at public schools for eligible 3- and 4-year-olds to help them get ready for kindergarten.
records.description_es: Prekínder gratis en las escuelas públicas para niños de 3 y 4 años que califican, para ayudarlos a prepararse para el kínder.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Child must be 4 by September 1 (or 3 by September 1 where a 3-year-old program exists) and meet one rule: learning English, eligible for free/reduced school lunch, homeless, military family, ever in foster care, child of a Star of Texas first responder, or child of a classroom teacher in the school district.
records.eligibility_summary_es: El niño debe tener 4 años para el 1 de septiembre (o 3 años para el 1 de septiembre donde haya programa para niños de 3 años) y cumplir con una de estas reglas: está aprendiendo inglés, califica para comidas escolares gratis o a precio reducido, no tiene hogar, es de familia militar, ha estado alguna vez en cuidado de crianza (foster care), es hijo de un primer respondedor con el premio Star of Texas, o es hijo de un maestro en ese distrito escolar.
records.how_to_apply: Contact or visit your local school district to enroll; pre-K enrollment is ongoing. The district will check your child's eligibility.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese o vaya a su distrito escolar local para inscribir a su hijo; la inscripción al prekínder está abierta todo el año. El distrito revisará si su hijo califica.
records.cost: Free for eligible children
records.notes: Economically disadvantaged = eligible for the National School Lunch Program (free or reduced-price meals). Homeless per McKinney-Vento definition. Districts verify eligibility and keep documents on file.

records.name: Free and Reduced-Price School Meals (School Lunch and Breakfast)
records.organization: Texas Department of Agriculture (USDA National School Lunch and School Breakfast Programs) with local schools
records.description_en: Free or low-cost breakfast and lunch at school. In Texas, students who qualify for reduced-price meals now eat breakfast and lunch free in the 2025-26 and 2026-27 school years.
records.description_es: Desayuno y almuerzo gratis o a bajo costo en la escuela. En Texas, los estudiantes que califican para comidas a precio reducido ahora comen desayuno y almuerzo gratis en los años escolares 2025-26 y 2026-27.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Students in families with low income, or families that get SNAP or other qualifying help. Families apply through their school district.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de familias con pocos ingresos, o de familias que reciben SNAP u otra ayuda que califica. Las familias solicitan a través de su distrito escolar.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out your school district's free and reduced-price meal application (online or paper). Ask your school's cafeteria or district office for the form.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de comidas gratis o a precio reducido de su distrito escolar (en internet o en papel). Pida el formulario en la cafetería de la escuela o en la oficina del distrito.
records.cost: Free (reduced-price-eligible students also eat free in Texas for SY 2025-26 and 2026-27)
records.notes: TDA help line (877) TEX-MEAL. State funding from the 89th Texas Legislature makes reduced-price breakfast and lunch free through SY 2026-27. Current income tables: https://squaremeals.org/FandN-Resources/Income-Eligibility-Guidelines (dollar amounts not captured this session).

records.name: Summer Meals for Kids (Summer Food Service Program / Seamless Summer Option)
records.description_en: Free meals for kids and teens during summer break at sites like schools, parks, and community centers in low-income areas.
records.description_es: Comidas gratis para niños y adolescentes durante las vacaciones de verano en lugares como escuelas, parques y centros comunitarios en zonas de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children and teens 18 years old and younger at sites in low-income areas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y adolescentes de 18 años o menos, en lugares ubicados en zonas de bajos ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Find a meal site using the Summer Meal Site Map or call (877) TEX-MEAL, then go to the site at meal time.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque un lugar de comidas en el Mapa de Sitios de Comidas de Verano o llame al (877) TEX-MEAL, y luego vaya al lugar a la hora de la comida.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: Seasonal - mainly when school is out in summer. Site list changes each year.

records.name: Early Childhood Intervention (ECI)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Services for babies and toddlers with developmental delays or disabilities, like speech, physical, and developmental therapy, often in the family's home.
records.description_es: Servicios para bebés y niños pequeños con retrasos en el desarrollo o discapacidades, como terapia del habla, terapia física y terapia del desarrollo, muchas veces en la casa de la familia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children from birth to 36 months with a developmental delay of at least 25% in one or more areas, certain medical diagnoses, or who are deaf/hard of hearing or blind/visually impaired. Anyone can make a referral.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde que nacen hasta los 36 meses con un retraso de al menos 25% en una o más áreas del desarrollo, ciertos diagnósticos médicos, o que son sordos o tienen problemas de audición, o son ciegos o tienen problemas de la vista. Cualquier persona puede referir a un niño.
records.how_to_apply: Find your local ECI program by city, county, or ZIP with the ECI Program Search and call their referral number. The program will do a free evaluation.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque su programa local de ECI por ciudad, condado o código postal en la Búsqueda de Programas ECI y llame a su número de referencias. El programa hará una evaluación gratis.
records.cost: Evaluation, case management, service plan, and interpreters are free; other services use a sliding fee based on family size and income
records.notes: 877-787-8999 is the HHS Office of the Ombudsman (select Option 3) for ECI help. Local ECI programs are listed as separate regional records.

records.name: Texas Education for Homeless Children and Youth (TEHCY) - McKinney-Vento Student Rights
records.description_en: Protects the school rights of children and teens without a stable home. Schools must enroll them right away and help with transportation, school supplies, and other supports.
records.description_es: Protege los derechos escolares de niños y adolescentes que no tienen un hogar estable. Las escuelas deben inscribirlos de inmediato y ayudar con transporte, útiles escolares y otros apoyos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Students experiencing homelessness as defined by the federal McKinney-Vento Act.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes que no tienen hogar según la definición de la ley federal McKinney-Vento.
records.how_to_apply: Tell the school or the district's homeless liaison about your living situation. For help, call the TEHCY Support Hotline or submit the TEHCY support intake form.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cuéntele a la escuela o al enlace para estudiantes sin hogar del distrito sobre su situación de vivienda. Para recibir ayuda, llame a la línea de apoyo de TEHCY o llene el formulario de solicitud de apoyo de TEHCY.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: Schools cannot require proof of residency, immunizations, birth certificates, or guardianship papers to enroll a homeless student. In Texas a homeless student may enroll in any district they choose. Right to transportation to school of origin. Title I can cover school supplies, dress-code clothing, immunizations, counseling, tutoring. Homeless children also qualify for Texas pre-K and Head Start. State coordinator: HomelessEducation@tea.texas.gov. Hotline 1-855-85TEHCY. Portal: https://tehcy.tea.texas.gov/

records.name: Foster Care and Student Success (School Foster Care Liaisons)
records.description_en: Every Texas school district and charter school has a foster care liaison who helps students in foster care enroll, transfer, and stay in the same school when possible.
records.description_es: Cada distrito escolar y escuela chárter de Texas tiene un enlace para cuidado de crianza (foster care) que ayuda a los estudiantes en foster care a inscribirse, cambiarse de escuela y quedarse en la misma escuela cuando sea posible.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Students in the conservatorship of the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (foster care) and their caregivers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes bajo la tutela del Departamento de Servicios para la Familia y de Protección de Texas (foster care) y las personas que los cuidan.
records.how_to_apply: Contact your district's foster care liaison (listed in the TEA AskTED directory) or email TEA at fostercareliaison@tea.texas.gov.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con el enlace de foster care de su distrito (aparece en el directorio AskTED de TEA) o escriba a TEA a fostercareliaison@tea.texas.gov.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: AskTED directory: https://tealprod.tea.state.tx.us/tea.askted.web/Forms/Home.aspx. Children ever in foster care also qualify for free Texas public pre-K.

records.name: TEA Parent Support Hub
records.description_en: Helps parents understand how Texas public schools work, their rights, enrolling in school, and how to solve problems with a school or district.
records.description_es: Ayuda a los padres a entender cómo funcionan las escuelas públicas de Texas, sus derechos, cómo inscribir a sus hijos y cómo resolver problemas con una escuela o distrito.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Parents and families of Texas public school students.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Padres y familias de estudiantes de escuelas públicas de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Parent Support Hub online or email ParentSupportProgram@tea.texas.gov. Use the Parent Complaint Navigator to find the right path for a concern.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el Parent Support Hub en internet o escriba a ParentSupportProgram@tea.texas.gov. Use el Parent Complaint Navigator para encontrar el mejor camino para su problema.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: (512) 463-9734 is TEA's main number. Offers a Parental Rights Handbook. General enrollment questions: (512) 463-9290, GeneralInquiry@tea.texas.gov. Special education enrollment: (512) 463-9414, sped@tea.texas.gov. School finder: AskTED directory.

records.name: TEA General Education Complaints
records.description_en: Lets parents file a written complaint with the state about a public school or district problem.
records.description_es: Permite a los padres presentar una queja por escrito ante el estado sobre un problema con una escuela pública o un distrito.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Parents and community members with a concern about a Texas public school, district, or charter school.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Padres y miembros de la comunidad con una preocupación sobre una escuela pública, distrito o escuela chárter de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: First use the Parent Complaint Navigator. Then submit the General Education Complaint Form online, or mail a paper form to TEA Complaints Management, 1701 N. Congress Ave., Austin, TX 78701-1494. Complaints must be in writing.
records.how_to_apply_es: Primero use el Parent Complaint Navigator. Luego envíe el Formulario de Queja de Educación General en internet, o mande por correo un formulario en papel a TEA Complaints Management, 1701 N. Congress Ave., Austin, TX 78701-1494. Las quejas deben ser por escrito.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: TEA does not accept complaints by phone. Usually try the local district grievance process first. Parent Complaint Navigator: https://tea.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cTQhQQ0A0uN3FmS

records.name: SPEDTex - Special Education Information Center
records.description_en: Free help for families of students with disabilities to understand special education, evaluations, IEPs/ARD meetings, and how to solve disagreements with the school.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para familias de estudiantes con discapacidades, para entender la educación especial, las evaluaciones, los planes IEP y las juntas ARD, y cómo resolver desacuerdos con la escuela.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families of Texas children who have or may have a disability.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de niños en Texas que tienen o podrían tener una discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call the SPEDTex line, email inquire@spedtex.org, or use the contact form on the website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de SPEDTex, escriba a inquire@spedtex.org o use el formulario de contacto en su sitio web.
records.cost: Free
records.notes: Also supports families with the Parent-Directed Special Education Services (PDSES) program.

records.name: Texas Education Freedom Accounts (TEFA)
records.organization: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts (administered by Odyssey)
records.description_en: Education savings accounts that parents can use for approved costs of private school or homeschooling instead of public school.
records.description_es: Cuentas de ahorro para la educación que los padres pueden usar para pagar gastos aprobados de escuela privada o educación en casa, en lugar de la escuela pública.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas children who can attend a Texas public school, pre-K, or kindergarten. If there are more applicants than funds, a lottery is used, with priority first for children with disabilities in households at or below 500% FPL, then households at or below 200% FPL, then 200-500% FPL, then above 500% FPL.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños de Texas que pueden asistir a una escuela pública, prekínder o kínder de Texas. Si hay más solicitudes que fondos, se hace una lotería con prioridad primero para niños con discapacidades en hogares con ingresos de hasta 500% del nivel federal de pobreza (FPL), luego hogares de hasta 200% del FPL, luego entre 200% y 500% del FPL, y luego más de 500% del FPL.
records.how_to_apply: The 2026-27 application window (Feb 4 - Mar 31, 2026) is closed. Join the interest list on the program website for 2027-28 updates.
records.how_to_apply_es: El periodo para solicitar para 2026-27 (del 4 de febrero al 31 de marzo de 2026) ya cerró. Anótese en la lista de interés en el sitio web del programa para recibir noticias sobre 2027-28.
records.cost: Free to apply
records.notes: 2026-27 amounts: $10,474 for private school students; up to $30,000 for students with disabilities (IEP on file); $2,000 for homeschool. The 2026-27 application window ran Feb 4 - Mar 31, 2026. Over 274,000 applications and 100,000+ awards for 2026-27. Not a child care program; relevant for school choice questions.

records.name: Child Care Services - Workforce Solutions Alamo
records.description_en: Local office for Texas child care scholarships (CCS). Helps low-income families pay for child care while parents work, look for work, or attend school or training.
records.description_es: Oficina local de las becas de cuidado infantil de Texas (CCS). Ayuda a familias con pocos ingresos a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos mientras los padres trabajan, buscan trabajo o van a la escuela o a una capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families living in Atascosa, Bandera, Bexar, Comal, Frio, Gillespie, Guadalupe, Karnes, Kendall, Kerr, McMullen, Medina, Wilson counties with children birth to 12 (up to 18 with a disability) who meet work/school hour and income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias que viven en los condados de Atascosa, Bandera, Bexar, Comal, Frio, Gillespie, Guadalupe, Karnes, Kendall, Kerr, McMullen, Medina y Wilson con niños desde recién nacidos hasta los 12 años (hasta los 18 si tienen una discapacidad) y que cumplen con las reglas de horas de trabajo o estudio y de ingresos.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Atascosa, Bandera, Bexar, Comal, Frio, Gillespie, Guadalupe, Karnes, Kendall, Kerr, McMullen, Medina, Wilson counties, Texas

records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en internet en Texas Child Care Connection (Parent Central): llene el formulario de elegibilidad y la solicitud para la lista de espera. Llame a la oficina local si necesita ayuda o quiere saber su lugar en la lista de espera.
records.cost: Free to apply; sliding-scale parent share of cost
records.notes: Toll-free 1-800-204-7905. 100 N Santa Rosa Street is the board administrative office; hours listed are for the child care phone lines. Email ccs@wsalamo.org. Counties from TWC Workforce Board Directory (July 16, 2026). records.eligibility_summary_en: Families living in Brewster, Culberson, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, Presidio counties with children birth to 12 (up to 18 with a disability) who meet work/school hour and income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias que viven en los condados de Brewster, Culberson, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis y Presidio con niños desde recién nacidos hasta los 12 años (hasta los 18 si tienen una discapacidad) y que cumplen con las reglas de horas de trabajo o estudio y de ingresos.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Brewster, Culberson, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, Presidio counties, Texas

records.cost: Free to apply; sliding-scale parent share of cost
records.notes: Eligibility hotline 915-887-2878. Program is called CareForce. Waitlist is about 6-12 months after prescreening (sometimes longer).
